**Other Ghoul Guides**

These perk cards will only unlock once you have turned into a Ghoul, and you will lose access to them if you revert back to being human.

When you become a Ghoul, any Human-only Perk Cards and Legendary Perk Cards will automatically unequip and become locked.

The game will clearly indicate which perk cards are locked and which ones remain available after your transformation.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8e4d845abdd744079f9b55c72af0e5c5~mv2.jpg)

If you are a Ghoul, you can share Ghoul perk cards like normal, but the effects won't apply to any Humans on your team. This also works the other way, if you are a Human and share Human-only perk cards, the effects will not be applied to any Ghouls on your team.

__Legendary Ghoul Perk Cards__

__Action Diet__

**SPECIAL:**

Legendary Perk Card

**Perk Card Description**

With each kill, this perk restores your health and refills your Feral Meter, reducing your feral state while replenishing your standard health bar.

- Rank 1: On kills, restore 2 HP and fill your Feral Meter by 2% (90 points).
- Rank 2: On kills, restore 4 HP and fill your Feral Meter by 3% (120 points).
- Rank 3: On kills, restore 6 HP and fill your Feral Meter by 4% (150 points).
- Rank 4: On kills, restore 8 HP and fill your Feral Meter by 5% (180 points).

**Note:** 

Your Feral Meter has a total of 7200 points.

This perk does NOT refill your Glow Meter—it only restores your normal HP.

**Card Rank and Cost:**

1/2/3/4 - 50/100/150 Perk Coins

**Level unlocks**

Level 50

**Calculator**

Not Required

**Image of new perk card:**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_07000d2b71b14081b2389f19f62b393a~mv2.jpg)

__Feral Rage__

**SPECIAL:**

Legendary Perk Card

**Perk Card Description**

When Feral, all Glow perk abilities cost less Glow.

- Rank 1: When Feral, all perk cards that use Glow will consume 20% less Glow.
- Rank 2: When Feral, all perk cards that use Glow will consume 30% less Glow.
- Rank 3: When Feral, all perk cards that use Glow will consume 40% less Glow.
- Rank 4: When Feral, all perk cards that use Glow will consume 50% less Glow.

**Note:** 

Your Feral Meter must be empty/at 0% for this perk card to activate.

Below are the penalties for being in a Feral state, so keep that in mind when deciding if this perk card is right for you and your build:

**Feral Meter: 0% (Starving/Empty)**

- +150% Melee Damage
- -5 Endurance
- -30 Max HP
- -99 Charisma
- -20 Max AP
- -300% Hip-fire Gun Accuracy & V.A.T.S. Accuracy & Range

**Card Rank and Cost:**

1/2/3/4 - 50/100/150 Perk Coins

**Level unlocks**

Level 50

**Calculator**

Not Required

**Image of new perk card:**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_28b90c4ccffa435dbb9dd8354534dedf~mv2.jpg)

This perk card has a Ghoul check on it, which means that if you share this perk card while on a team, the reduced radiation resistance will only apply to other Ghoul characters on your team.

Note: This perk is useful for Ghouls who want to maintain a high Glow level while wearing high Rad Resistance armor such as Secret Service or Marine armor. By reducing your radiation resistance, you can absorb more radiation.

Feral Rage reduces the Glow consumption based on rank but only activates when the Feral Meter is at Starving/Empty.

- Feral Rage Rank 1 – Energy weapons consume 4 Glow per attack.
- Feral Rage Rank 2 – Energy weapons consume 3.5 Glow per attack.
- Feral Rage Rank 3 – Energy weapons consume 3 Glow per attack.
- Feral Rage Rank 4 – Energy weapons consume 2.5 Glow per attack.

#### **Conditions:**

- The player must be a Ghoul.
- The player must have at least 5 points of Glow.
- The player must be using an energy weapon.
- Gun-bashing does not trigger this effect.

**SPECIAL:**

Charisma

**Base:**

- It drains at 1 point per second.
- It takes 120 minutes (2 hours) to go from Full (Wonderful) to Empty (Feral).

**With Moral Support Perk Card equipped:** 

- The Feral Meter has 7,200 points.
- It drains at 0.5 points per second.
- It takes 240 minutes (4 hours) to go from Full (Wonderful) to Empty (Feral).

**Notes:**

- The perk requires at least one other teammate to activate. Being on a public team alone does not trigger the effect.
- The perk does not check for player type, meaning it activates whether your teammates are ghouls or humans.
